descriptor: Lighting studio and lantern makers by the harbour

voice.summary: Sounds like a founder telling the story over a cup of tea: warm, specific and funny about the early days. Years and details carry the story, and the tone stays modest even when the studio is not.
dos: Anchor each milestone to a year and a concrete detail
Use plain words like desk, kettle and lantern
Let the founders appear as we
donts: Do not claim to have changed the world
Do not use startup origin-myth cliches
Do not skip the hard years

taglines: Two desks, a kettle, a lantern
Made by the harbour, for any room
Our story, one lantern at a time
boilerplate: Lanternworks is a lighting studio by the harbour that has made hand-built lanterns for twelve years, growing from two desks and a kettle to a team of twelve.
